prompt: Name a Greek god or goddess

answers.name: Zeus
answers.fact: King of the gods, who threw thunderbolts.

answers.name: Poseidon
answers.fact: God of the sea, earthquakes and horses.

answers.name: Hades
answers.fact: God of the underworld, but not usually counted an Olympian.

answers.name: Athena
answers.fact: Sprang fully armed from Zeus's head.

answers.name: Apollo
answers.fact: God of the sun, music and prophecy.

answers.name: Ares
answers.fact: God of war, unpopular even with his parents.

answers.name: Hera
answers.fact: Queen of the gods, and Zeus's long-suffering wife.

answers.name: Artemis
answers.fact: Goddess of the hunt, Apollo's twin.

answers.name: Nike
answers.fact: Goddess of victory, before she was a shoe.

answers.name: Hephaestus
answers.fact: The blacksmith god, who built Olympus's palaces.

answers.name: Persephone
answers.fact: Queen of the underworld, half of every year.

answers.name: Hestia
answers.fact: Goddess of the hearth, who gave her Olympus seat to Dionysus.

answers.name: Eros
answers.fact: God of love; the Romans called him Cupid.

answers.name: Uranus
answers.fact: The sky, overthrown by his son Cronus.

answers.name: Cronus
answers.fact: The Titan who swallowed his children.

answers.name: Rhea
answers.fact: Saved Zeus by giving Cronus a stone to swallow.

answers.name: Helios
answers.fact: Drove the sun across the sky in a chariot.

answers.name: Nyx
answers.fact: Primordial night, feared even by Zeus.

answers.name: Chaos
answers.fact: The void that came before everything.

answers.name: Pan
answers.fact: God of the wild, with goat legs.

answers.name: Asclepius
answers.fact: God of medicine, with the snake-wrapped staff.

answers.name: Hebe
answers.fact: Goddess of youth, cupbearer to the gods.

answers.name: Eris
answers.fact: Goddess of discord, who started the Trojan War with an apple.

answers.name: Oceanus
answers.fact: The Titan of the world-encircling ocean.

answers.name: Themis
answers.fact: Titan of justice; Lady Justice is based on her.

answers.name: Mnemosyne
answers.fact: Titan of memory, mother of the Muses.

answers.name: Metis
answers.fact: Zeus's first wife, whom he swallowed.

answers.name: Triton
answers.fact: Poseidon's son, with a conch shell.

answers.name: Amphitrite
answers.fact: Queen of the sea, Poseidon's wife.

answers.name: Nereus
answers.fact: The old man of the sea.

answers.name: Tartarus
answers.fact: The pit below the underworld, and its god.

answers.name: Phanes
answers.fact: A golden-winged first-born god of creation.

answers.name: Chronos
answers.fact: Primordial time, often confused with Cronus.

answers.name: Theia
answers.fact: Titan of sight, mother of the sun and moon.

answers.name: Epimetheus
answers.fact: Prometheus's slow-witted brother, who married Pandora.

answers.name: Deimos
answers.fact: God of dread, now a moon of Mars.

answers.name: Phobos
answers.fact: God of fear, also a moon of Mars.

answers.name: Ganymede
answers.fact: A Trojan prince who became cupbearer to the gods.

answers.name: Palaemon
answers.fact: A sea god who rode a dolphin.

answers.name: Kratos
answers.fact: God of strength, long before the video game.

answers.name: Hermaphroditus
answers.fact: The child of Hermes and Aphrodite, merged with a nymph.

answers.name: Momus
answers.fact: God of mockery, kicked off Olympus for criticising too much.
